doc: Read a 3D rigid world's bodies and what touched what, cast a ray into it, push a body, step it, return to a frame, and ask what would be.

tools.name: rigid3.observe
tools.description: The frame, the state's hash, how many bodies and how many awake, and what began and ended touching in the last step

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: contacts are left out from the last, and `more` says how many

tools.name: rigid3.bodies
tools.description: Each body's id, kind, place, turn, velocity and whether it is awake, in the order made

tools.name: rigid3.ray
tools.description: The first body a segment meets: which, how far along, where and the surface's normal there

tools.name: rigid3.push
tools.description: An impulse on a body, given on the next step: through its centre of mass, or at a point in the world
tools.undo: rigid3.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: step the world: the push acts on the next step

at.description: [x, y, z], where in the world it is given (its centre of mass when none is given)

tools.name: rigid3.step
tools.undo: rigid3.seek to the frame it began at

steps.description: how many (1 when none is given)

tools.name: rigid3.seek
tools.description: Returns to a frame within the history kept, bit for bit (a checkpoint and the pushes since, played again); what is stepped from there is a new branch
tools.undo: none within the world: what came after the frame is another branch's

then.why: read the world at the frame returned to

tools.name: rigid3.branch
tools.description: What would be: the world some steps ahead, a body pushed first if one is given, observed as rigid3.observe does; the world itself untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

tasks.name: see-what-is-there
tasks.summary: Read the bodies, then what lies straight down from above

tasks.name: push-and-watch
tasks.summary: Push a body, step the world, and read what it struck

tasks.name: ask-before-pushing
tasks.summary: See what a push would do some steps ahead, the world itself untouched
